title: The Starting Figure of a Circle Membership Year's Credit
content:
## The figure a Circle membership year's credit starts from

Where the profile holds a plan under Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans, the standing of that plan and
its payout entries decide the figure the year's credit on a Northbeam Circle Membership starts from.

| Standing of the plan | Claims paid on it in the 12 months ending on the handling day | The figure the year's credit starts from |
|---|---|---|
| Active or in claim hold | One or more | The deductible figure that plan carries |
| Active or in claim hold | None | The service credit figure of the tier |
| Any other standing | Any | The anniversary reward figure of the tier |

Where the plan the profile holds stands active or in claim hold and a claim has been paid on it in the
twelve months ending on the handling day, the figure the year's credit starts from is the deductible figure
that plan carries, so that the next repair costs the member nothing. Where that plan stands active or in
claim hold and no claim has been paid on it in that window, the figure the year's credit starts from is the
service credit figure of the tier. Where no plan on the profile stands active or in claim hold, the figure
the year's credit starts from is the anniversary reward figure of the tier.

## The two tier figures the readings turn on

| Tier | Anniversary reward figure (USD) | Service credit figure (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 10.00 | 0.00 |
| Circle Total Annual | 40.00 | 50.00 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 50.00 | 60.00 |
| Circle Business Pro | 75.00 | 200.00 |
| Circle Business Elite | 300.00 | 750.00 |

## Points of judgement

*A plan standing in a claim hold with a payout booked two months ago.* The first reading applies, and the
figure the year's credit starts from is the deductible that plan carries, whatever the tier's own credit
figures are.

*A plan standing active with its last claim paid eighteen months ago.* That payout falls outside the twelve
months ending on the handling day, so the second reading applies and the service credit figure of the tier is
the starting figure — 0.00 on Circle Plus Annual, 750.00 on Circle Business Elite.

*No plan on the profile standing active or in claim hold.* The third reading applies and the anniversary
reward figure of the tier is the starting figure — 10.00 on Circle Plus Annual, 300.00 on Circle Business
Elite.
